_about: The throws of the grapple on A, by the send (docs/combat/grapple-hybrid.md section 2): for each send (across toward, across away, down, up) the thrower's sequence for each fighter (the wave pair3, render/anim/tools/waves/pair3.mjs, prefix zq: the load, the release and the follow, the thrower's own side only; the held body is the sim's and the ragdoll's). Nothing plays them until the sim has a held state and the grip layer (docs/animation/clinch-sizing.md slice C2) puts the hands on the rival's body; the data is here so the layer, the scans and Combat's table agree. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

grip._note: where each throw's hands take hold on the rival (the regions in sockets.json); the clinch's grip layer will solve each hand onto its region
